## What’s new
- Adds referral-payment email previews directly in Beacon, with a cleaner payment-detail layout and a guarded delivery workflow. - Keeps referral email delivery in Hannah-only test mode while the workflow is reviewed. - Adds optional contact profile photos and uses them in contact and payable views, falling back to initials when no photo is available. - Cleans up payable reporting, including removing the no-longer-relevant Due in column from paid payables. - Streamlines account settings with side-by-side name fields, modal password workflows, and dashboard routing after sign-in.
## Reliability
- Improves billing-rule parity, local finance caching, system-health visibility, and client-app time-log delivery safeguards.

## Fixed
- The Cash Flow dashboard now lists projected referral payments that are waiting for client invoices to be paid. - Each projected row shows the client, invoice, expected client-payment date, referrer, and projected payout, and opens the source invoice when selected. - The Waiting on clients total now includes those projected payouts without double-counting legacy blocked payables.

## Fixed
- Referral payables now display their contractual due date, 30 days after client payment, instead of the payment date. - The Days column now counts down to that contractual due date.

## What’s new
- Streamlined invoicing with a full-screen draft workflow, live time-log edits, and a clearer QuickBooks handoff with success confirmation. - Added subscription billing support, payment history, and revenue-share calculations. - Improved payable and QuickBooks bill readiness so approved obligations can move directly into payment. - Added automatic recovery when a session expires, longer-lived sign-ins, password reset by email, and Apple Passwords support. - Added the role-scoped client and subcontractor portal foundation.
## Reliability
- Improved live Convex synchronization and release signing for the new secure-login entitlement.

# Beacon 1.0.6
- Added a fully isolated Showcase Mode that uses Beacon's production interface with realistic fake data and blocks production data, QuickBooks, Quickbase, and other external connections. - Updated Day and Week calendars to prioritize billable work, show earned revenue, and keep personal-project time secondary. - Added billable hours and earned revenue to every day in the Week calendar while removing the project icons from day headings. - Renamed the Current Work cards to Today, This week, and This month for clearer language. - Hardened test launches so they cannot restore production authentication or connect to production services.

# Beacon 1.0.5
- Added a dedicated Subscriptions workspace with full record editing, payment history, and revenue-share reporting. - Added person-scoped subscription access for Developer users while keeping unrelated subscriptions hidden. - Added interactive dashboard and finance-report drill-downs, sortable report tables, and direct links to related records. - Standardized time-log reporting across company and dashboard views, including daily resource-grouped detail. - Improved live dashboard/report refresh behavior and removed obsolete manual refresh and Quickbase-authority messaging.

## What’s new
- Makes finance navigation much faster by keeping live data subscriptions warm and reducing unnecessary whole-window redraws. - Keeps invoices, payments, payables, dashboards, companies, projects, contacts, and reports updated live when Beacon or QuickBooks data changes. - Automatically creates referral payables when qualifying client invoices are paid, with chronological Beacon payable numbers and clearer source details. - Creates QuickBooks bills through the shared Beacon connection, opens QuickBooks to unpaid bills, and improves bill status and error handling. - Simplifies the Payables workflow and standardizes payable and invoice-line tables with the rest of the app. - Includes the latest company, project, contact, user-permission, related-time-log, and QuickBooks customer-linking improvements. - Fixes an activity-update feedback loop and reduces unnecessary background work.
After updating, Beacon will keep finance screens current automatically as shared data changes.

## What’s new
- Fixes daily analysis drafts that contain a malformed client or project ID when the displayed client and project names uniquely identify the correct Beacon records. - Shows a warning whenever Beacon safely corrects those IDs before presenting the recommendation. - Continues to reject ambiguous matches or IDs that point to a different real record.
After updating, choose **Analyze day** again for any day that previously showed the catalog-validation error.

## What’s new
- Adds signed automatic updates, so Beacon only needs to be installed manually once. - Adds the finance-only AP/AR workspace with access to Cash Flow and Reports. - Applies role-based navigation and permissions for owner and AP/AR accounts. - Includes the latest company, contact, project, time-log, and QuickBooks workflow improvements.
Beacon checks for updates every six hours and installs downloaded updates after the app quits.
